about: Daniel D. Dolan, II is an attorney who represents clients in the Miami, Florida area. Daniel Dolan, II is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Daniel Dolan, II chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended St. Thomas University School of Law and graduated in 1996. Daniel Dolan, II passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1996.

He represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Plaintiff and Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Daniel Dolan, II has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
